author: Spoookeh
body:
May I present to you Strike!

Creator: Spookeh
Contributors: Prodigy4532
Server hosted by: alexanderjoe
Gamemode: TDM

It features 1 gapple spawner, 2 arrow spawners, scoreboxes and a few void areas.

YML: https://github.com/Prodigy4532/Prodigy4532XML/blob/master/YML%2520-%2520Avicus/Strike%2520TDM.yml
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/22il1o52p057h11/SpookzTDM.rar
Video: https://youtu.be/mLMJcPzpV_M

You can have a look around by going on to alexanderjoe's server and typing /mvtp SpookzTDM
